text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide takes first place! The
champion of
this year's Kikuka Sho is
Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes! My calculations were right!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide sure is amazing! She's a
totally different runner than she was
before summer!
Even her physique looks
a little different.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
She must have trained a lot. There's no
doubt
she's the strongest BNW member!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But that was an amazing race... I have no
regrets!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide! I'm gonna get even stronger until our next race! We have to race again!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket... Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We must run together once more—all
three of us.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you can see...
that I'm not okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haha... I'm pathetic.

I help her stand once she manages to
stagger up,
and we make it back to the
waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry for... you know, ruining everything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Come on. You and I both know I did.
choice_data_list: You're not a bother at all...!
You're not a bother at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
When I saw how Hayahide and Ticket were
getting stronger and stronger, I
panicked and got
reckless and messed
up all your plans.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And look at what happened.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No wonder everyone looks down on me.
I'm just a
tiny weakling...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I KNOW!
choice_data_list: Nobody thinks that way at all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Okay? I know the others at school
believe in me
and there are people
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
They've always believed in me—in what I
can do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I've always known that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I get it...
That's not what I mean though...
It's me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The one who doesn't believe in me, who
calls me short, spineless, and messed
up—who thinks I'm
completely
worthless...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's always been me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...This was all pointless.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who doesn't believe in
myself. So running to show other people
that there's more to
me than what they
see... It was all for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Look, I'm sorry. I'm just tired.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I need a break from training... and from
racing.
